subject: CAIQ control dependency inventory and evidence QC schedule
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@cobaltfin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: control dependency questions + evidence cadence

Hi Logan / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our compliance team has started the CAIQ and we hit a couple of questions around control dependencies for Redwood's hosted inference: specifically how controls for KV cache, model routing, and telemetry are covered across Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.

Can you: 
- Confirm which CAIQ controls map to the KV cache and routing subsystems (we want the control owners and evidence types).
- Share a short list of the runtime artifacts you can provide as evidence (sampling of telemetry, config manifests, keystore rotation logs).
- Propose a target window for us to review a first bundle — our auditors would like a one-week QC window.

I've attached our initial scope sheet (CAIQ_Scope_Map_v1.xlsx) with the questions highlighted. Prefer to keep this scoped to Hosted + Dedicated first; we may expand to Private afterwards.

Appreciate your help,

Sarah Liu
Senior InfoSec Manager, CobaltFin
security@cobaltfin.com

Attachment: CAIQ_Scope_Map_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@cobaltfin.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 12:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: control dependency questions + evidence cadence

Sarah — thanks for the clear scope. Taking ownership and proposing a lightweight plan below.

Quick answers up front:
- KV cache and routing controls are represented across CAIQ controls in the Data Security (DS) and Operational Controls (OP) families; primary owners are Platform Runtime and Serving (we'll call out exact control IDs in the mapping).
- Evidence we can provide for a first pass: configuration manifests (git snapshots), sampled runtime traces (redacted), KV cache hit/miss telemetry (time-windowed CSV), and key rotation attestations (keystore audit).

Proposed plan (one-week QC window):
1) Today (Fri): internal kickoff and owner assignment (we'll mark control owners in the spreadsheet). — Logan
2) Mon/Tue: Aditya to produce control-by-control mapping and drop artifacts to the shared Drive folder. — Aditya
3) Wed: Marissa to assemble telemetry samples and the runtime trace samples (redaction applied). — Marissa
4) Thu: Kimberly to review the bundle for completeness and answer any CAIQ note fields.
5) Fri: Deliver first bundle to CobaltFin for your one-week QC.

I'll attach a brief task list and will annotate your CAIQ_Scope_Map_v1.xlsx in Drive. Can you confirm the preferred delivery format (zip vs DocuSign link for heavier artifacts)?

— Logan Wright
Director, Product Security | Redwood Inference
LoganW@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: control dependency questions + evidence cadence

Logan / Kimberly — started the mapping and dropped a baseline in the Drive folder (link below). Summary of work completed:

- Control inventory: created a tab that groups CAIQ control IDs by runtime subsystem (Serving runtime, Batching layer, KV cache, Model-routing, Telemetry).
- Evidence pointers: for each control we have a primary artifact type (e.g., git snapshot, runtime trace, S3 object path) and a supporting narrative.
- Questions for CobaltFin (short):
  1) For DS-5 related controls, do you require raw log excerpts or redacted samples? We can do both but need to know auditor preference.
  2) For controls referencing key management, is a signer attestation sufficient or do you require HSM audit logs?

Attachments placed to Drive: redwood_caiq_mapping_v0.9.xlsx, redwood_evidence_sample_kv.txt (small sample showing KV hit/miss counts with timestamps).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2Bcaiq-mapping-sprint

I'll aim to have the full bundle ready for Marissa by Wednesday evening.

— Aditya Rao
Security Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

> On Fri, 18 Jun 2027 at 12:31, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Sarah — thanks for the clear scope...

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: control dependency questions + evidence cadence

All — confirmed owners in the Drive workbook (Owner column filled). A few clarifications:

- For DS-5 (logging privacy), we will provide time-windowed redacted traces and a short redaction note; that should satisfy the auditor unless they insist on raw logs.
- For key management: we can deliver HSM rotation attestations and KMS audit exports; HSM raw logs are available under an NDA, but signer attestation + KMS exports have worked for similar customers.
- Delivery format: we'll produce a signed zip (DocuSign for chain of custody is welcome but optional for this first pass).

Marissa — please prioritize the telemetry CSV and one runtime trace sample so we can bundle on Thursday.

Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
